title: Premium Schedule, Due Day and Grace Period for the Special Needs Plans Category
content:
The plan premium a member of a Special Needs Plans package is billed each coverage month, the calendar day of the coverage month on which that premium falls due, the calendar days that run after a first unpaid premium before termination may be processed, and the Part B premium bought down on the member's behalf are all fixed by the package.

## Premium schedule

| Plan benefit package | Monthly plan premium, USD | Due day of the coverage month | Grace period, calendar days | Part B premium bought down each month, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 0.00 | 5 | 90 | 185.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 0.00 | 5 | 90 | 185.00 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 0.00 | 5 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 0.00 | 5 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 18.70 | 5 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 0.00 | 5 | 90 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the columns

1. **Monthly plan premium.** The plan premium billed to the member each coverage month, in USD.
2. **Due day of the coverage month.** The calendar day of the coverage month on which the premium falls due. Every package in the Special Needs Plans category carries day 5.
3. **Grace period.** The calendar days after the first unpaid premium before termination may be processed. Every package in the category carries 90 calendar days.
4. **Part B premium bought down.** The Part B premium the state or the plan pays on the member's behalf each month, in USD.

## Points of judgement

**Which packages carry a plan premium of their own?** Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) carries a monthly plan premium of 18.70 USD. Each of the other five packages carries 0.00 USD.

**Which packages carry a Part B premium bought down?** Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) and Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) each carry 185.00 USD a month. The remaining four packages carry 0.00 USD.

**Do the due day and the grace period differ between packages?** They do not. Day 5 of the coverage month and 90 calendar days are carried by every package in the Special Needs Plans category alike.
